decisions.reason: The operator line is a visible, resource-intensive part of the firm's one-source garage door offering, so management will persist with it even though the website no longer showed it in 2020 and 2021.
The remote-controlled operator rounds out the operator line the firm has committed to, and its absence from the website can still be read as a temporary presentation change rather than failure.
Glazed industrial sectional doors belong to the core industrial range and share production with other doors, so management keeps them despite their low visibility after 2019.
The insulated glazed door supports the firm's announced thermal-solution direction, and the investment in it calls for justification, which favors keeping it.
